name: Sabores Mild Coconut Chicken Curry or Chicken Pad Thai (No Peanuts/Lime)
whyItWorks: Dairy-free coconut milk yellow curry with tender chicken, soft potatoes, and white jasmine rice—or mild rice-noodle Pad Thai without crushed peanuts—provides comforting, lactose-free warmth.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order Mild (spice level 0/1) Chicken Yellow Curry with white rice, or Chicken Pad Thai with no crushed peanuts, no raw bean sprouts, and no lime wedge.
watchOuts: Skip crushed peanuts, raw bean sprouts, chili flakes, and lime wedges on Pad Thai
